_meta.session: Session 68 — Anthropic Fable/Mythos 5 PDF deep re-mine
_meta.notes: Second-pass deep re-mine of 26MB system card PDF. S65 covered sections 8.2/8.4/8.20.1-2 only. This session extracts sections 8.5 (Frontier SWE), 8.7 (CursorBench), 8.8 (GPQA Diamond extended), 8.9 (RiemannBench), 8.10 (USAMO 2026), 8.11 (ArxivMath), 8.12 (CritPt), 8.13 (GraphWalks), 8.16.4-9 (multimodal), 8.17 (real-world tasks), 8.18 (HealthBench), 8.19 (multilingual GMMLU/MILU/INCLUDE), 8.20.3-7 (life sciences). 10+ NEW SOTAs identified. 5 NEW benchmarks: cursorbench, riemannbench, frontier_swe (lower-better, ranking score), structural_biology_openended, labbench2. Discrepancy resolved: AA page showed Mythos 5 CritPt 4% (chart bug?), PDF authoritative 28.6%.
